newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,448 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,448 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 2,448 contracts led by volume in corn for a second straight day, according to the CBOT.
There were 167 wheat, 1,468 corn, 740 soybean, 35 soymeal and 38 soyoil futures contracts traded, along with 6 wheat put and 16 soybean call options.
The overnight trend for corn was up one to 5-1/4 cents per bushel, soybeans up 4-1/2 to 5-3/4 cents, wheat up 1/2 to 1-1/2 cents, soymeal up $2.40 to $2.60 a ton and soyoil up 0.10 cent a lb.
